title: Antimatroid characterization of RAF interior operators
summary: Addressing the RAF-realizability question in Section 4 of Mike Steel's Interior Operators and Their Relationship to Autocatalytic Networks (arXiv:2305.16714v4, 2023), we characterize which interior operators on the subsets of a finite set E are maxRAF operators of catalytic reaction systems whose reaction set is exactly E. An interior operator is represented by its family of fixed sets, a union-closed family containing the empty set.
